input: One raw UTF-8 JSON object or array. No HTML/script extraction, URL fetching or remote contexts.
limit_behavior: Byte/container-depth caps are checked before parsing or traversal; object/value/string/pointer caps use iterative traversal. Exceeding a limit stops the run without a partial exported inventory.
syntax: Native JSON.parse. Syntax errors produce JSON_SYNTAX_ERROR, no entity rows and reference coverage NOT_INSPECTED. A portable numeric parser location is included when available; native input snippets are not copied to Markdown.

root_shapes.object: Inspect its nested objects. Empty objects yield NO_ENTITY_OBJECTS.
root_shapes.array: Inspect objects in order, including nested arrays. Primitive values are visited for limits but are not entity objects. Empty arrays yield NO_ENTITY_OBJECTS.
root_shapes.primitive: JSON_PARSED with entity inventory NOT_INSPECTED_UNSUPPORTED_ROOT and reference coverage NOT_INSPECTED. Never a graph-valid result.

entity_rows: Objects outside @context, except empty objects, pure @graph/@context containers and @value/@list/@set wrappers. Nested objects of those wrappers are still inspected, except context contents. Untyped node objects remain visible.
order: Depth-first supplied array/member order. Entity row is sequential 1..N and is not an input line number. JSON pointers use RFC6901 escaping; root pointer is the empty string.
types: Only literal @type string/string-array values are inventoried as supplied labels. No term/IRI/vocabulary or keyword-alias expansion; absent or unusual type values are observations, not full validity decisions.
contexts: Record supplied context kind per object; do not fetch, expand, apply or inherit contexts. Context contents count toward limits but do not become entity rows or ID definitions.
id_only_reference: Exactly one member, @id, whose value is a string, including the empty string. A non-string @id is retained as a shape observation and not indexed.
id_definition: Object with a string @id and another member besides @id/@context. Separate definition objects with an identical string remain separate; no merge or conflict inference.
matching: Exact supplied @id strings. No trim, case folding, percent/trailing-slash/Unicode normalization, base resolution, URL request or reference traversal. @id strings with cycles do not cause linked-graph recursion.
unmatched_reference: A string beginning with an RFC3986-style scheme prefix (letter then letters/digits/+/./- then colon) has external-definition UNKNOWN. All other unmatched strings are local coverage gaps, including fragments, relative paths, blank-node labels and empty strings. This lexical classification is not IRI validation or proof of a published broken link.
duplicate_member_names: Native JSON.parse retains the last supplied value of repeated member names in a single object. Duplicate member names are not separately diagnosed. This differs from multiple separate definition objects sharing @id, which are retained for review.
exports: Results CSV is the entity inventory; findings CSV uses controlled row labels; readable Markdown report; JSON input manifest with Worker SHA-256, separate state dimensions and limits. The unchanged shared CSV serializer quotes cells and prefixes common spreadsheet formula-leading values.
not_performed: Google required/recommended property or rich-result eligibility checks
